votes.motion: Commissioner Draper made a motion to recommend approval of a condition use permit for Commerce Point Bldg. 1100 with the plan that is shown that they have enough parking stalls and enough landscaping to satisfy the staff.
Commissioner Curtis made a motion to recommend approval of Item 3 a general plan amendment from COM to HDR located at 900 South and 250 West intersection.

Commissioner Larsen made a motion to recommend approval of Item 4A a rezone to PD-R (Planned Development Residential) on approximately 60.26 acres and PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) on approximately 16.66 acres. The applicant is also seeking approval of the first phase which is approximately 14.25 acres and would have 10 apartment buildings and 244 units as staff has presented including the developer’s agreement that the amenities will be developed with the buildings, they will develop the sidewalk along Dixie Drive, they will work with staff on the alignment of Gap Canyon Drive, they will come in with a more detailed plan with areas 2-7 we are only approving the general density for the pod areas and are recommending approval of area 1. Discussion on use list for the commercial portion AMENDED MOTION: Above motion with the use table being modified as follows: 1. Removal of all references to outdoor storage and display 2. Removal of overnight stays in the mental health facilities and the counseling center 3. Remove automobile rental 4. Remove Car Wash 5. Remove Tire Sales and Service 6. Remove alcohol establishments 7. Remove RV Storage 8. Remove Communication Transmission facilities over 50 feet 9. Add under 50 feet and permitted with standards to Communication Transmission facilities 10. Add the language: limited to the following uses to all bold headings.

Commissioner Curtis made a motion to recommend approval of item 4B to City Council to change the zone from A-1 to RE-37.5 on approximately 12.40 acres generally located on the north side of 2450 South between 3430 East and Crimson Cliffs Way.
Commissioner Larsen made a motion to recommend approval of Item 5 a zone change amendment as presented by staff including staff comments.
Commissioner Kemp made a motion to recommend approval of changes to 10-17B-8 as it relates to the Conditional Use permits as further clarified by City legal counsel.
Commissioner Curtis made a motion to approve the minutes as submitted
